title: בן סירא

paragraphs: Ben Sira is Yeshua ben Sirakh or Sira. Some say son of Yehoshua the High Priest, Ezra 3 and Ḥaggai; see the opening of Shevet Yehudah, which gives the relationship as grandson. Likkutei Maharil says he was Yirmeyah's son, his mother Yirmeyah's daughter, who conceived in a bath. נ״ד [work unresolved], year 3448, writes: in my opinion this is mere exaggeration; I found it neither in Talmud nor heard from my teachers that it occurs in aggadah or midrash. End of quotation. He means conception in a bath is exaggeration and false. He did not see Ḥagigah 15a, 'She conceived in a bath.' See R. Zeira and Ben Sira's introduction. Shalshelet HaKabbalah, 19b [source ש״ק], says Ben Sira was Yirmeyah's son by his daughter, apparently from Ketubbot. End of quotation. I saw nothing of this in Ketubbot. Some say he lived in Shimon the Righteous's days and his grandson Ben Sira completed his work. See part 1, years 3298 and 3448.
